caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The horse is brown with darker shading to indicate contours and features, including a lighter brown section around the mouth and a highlighted eye. It has a carved head, ears, and a black or dark brown tail that extends from the rear. The horse’s back features a red saddle with a black paisley or floral-like pattern and two vertical red supports for holding. The legs of the horse are attached to a sturdy, elongated, curved wooden rocking base colored in dark brown with visible wood texture and grain. Below the center of the rocking base, there is an additional rectangular dark slab or seat positioned horizontally. The artist’s signature, “Lester G. Knessa,” appears in small, neat handwriting to the lower right of the horse. The drawing uses muted, naturalistic colors with emphasis on brown and red tones, and the image is symmetrical with the horse facing to the left. There are no other objects or decorations present on the plain background.
title: Wooden Rocking Horse
